name: rsicraft
description: rsicraft L3: Native eframe/egui 0.37 GPU Desktop Studio for Sovereign Recursive Self-Improvement on RTX 4090.

tools.name: rsi_status
tools.description: Return stigmergic SQLite store statistics, card counts, and Goliath RTX 4090 summary.

tools.name: rsi_hardware_profile
tools.description: Return the Goliath RTX 4090 (24 GB VRAM) + Frontis-MA1 30B/35B MoE hardware profile and llama-server launch command.

tools.name: rsi_task_upsert
tools.description: Create or update an evolutionary optimization task and its sandbox evaluator script.

tools.name: rsi_task_list
tools.description: List all registered optimization tasks.

tools.name: rsi_task_show
tools.description: Show a task, its score/delta bounds, and its current top frontier.

tools.name: rsi_step
tools.description: Execute a single evolutionary step (DRAFT, IMPROVE, DEBUG, or CROSSOVER) with composite-utility parent selection, LLM synthesis, sandbox evaluation, and BLAKE3+Zstd CAS persistence.

tools.name: rsi_campaign
tools.description: Run a multi-step autonomous evolutionary campaign cycling across DRAFT, IMPROVE, DEBUG, and CROSSOVER.

tools.name: rsi_get_frontier
tools.description: Get the top-K materialized frontier experience cards for a task.

tools.name: rsi_card_list
tools.description: List experience cards for a task ordered by composite utility, optionally filtered by operator or execution status.

tools.name: rsi_card_show
tools.description: Show full details of one experience card including decompressed source code, BLAKE3 hash, execution logs, and lineage.

tools.name: rsi_lineage
tools.description: Return the evolutionary lineage DAG (nodes and parent->child edges) for a task.

tools.name: rsi_evaluate
tools.description: Directly evaluate a candidate Python code snippet against a task's evaluator and optionally record it as an experience card.

tools.name: rsi_demo_seed
tools.description: Seed an empty database with the spec's 'opt-synth' (Vector Max) benchmark task and a 4-card evolutionary progression.

tools.name: rsi_help
tools.description: Query the 9-tab RSICraft Operator Manual, RSI Geopolitics ('Skynet' vs Closed Labs), Tsinghua/Frontis.AI OpenRSI Dossier, and Competitive Matrix (tabs: overview, rsi_landscape, tsinghua_openrsi, wrappee, operators, compare, api, troubleshoot, faq, all) with op...

tools.name: rsi_diff
tools.description: Generate a unified text diff comparing decompressed source codes between two experience cards (e.g. parent vs child).

tools.name: rsi_llm_probe
tools.description: Actively ping the configured LLM endpoint (/v1/models), returning reachability status, latency in ms, and active model alias.

tools.name: rsi_hyperparams_get
tools.description: Get current composite utility weights (w_score, w_delta, w_novelty) used for stochastic parent selection.

tools.name: rsi_hyperparams_set
tools.description: Set composite utility weights (w_score, w_delta, w_novelty). The weights are persisted in the store and every task is re-ranked immediately.

tools.name: rsi_task_delete
tools.description: Delete a task and cascade delete all its associated experience cards and frontier records.

tools.name: rsi_cards_prune
tools.description: Prune low-utility non-frontier experience cards for a task, keeping at least keep_frontier top cards.

tools.name: rsi_export
tools.description: Export a complete task lineage bundle (task definition, decompressed CAS cards, and Pareto frontier) to JSON.

tools.name: rsi_import
tools.description: Import a complete task lineage bundle from JSON into the stigmergic SQLite store.

tools.name: rsi_dataset_export
tools.description: Rung 2 Self-Evolution: Export curated SFT trajectories (positive deltas, error repairs) and DPO contrastive preference pairs from the task DAG.

tools.name: rsi_bandit_status
tools.description: Advisory operator statistics for a task: per-operator pulls, wins, Beta posterior parameters and a recommended next operator. Not Thompson sampling yet and not used by campaigns.

tools.name: rsi_train_step
tools.description: Post-train a LoRA adapter on the task's curated SFT traces with sandboxes/train_lora.py (needs RSICRAFT_TRAIN_BASE_MODEL and a CUDA Python environment). Produces a candidate adapter only; the active model changes only through rsi_promote_gate.

tools.name: rsi_promote_gate
tools.description: A/B gate between two model aliases served by the LLM endpoint: runs `trials` fresh searches of `steps` steps per model on scratch copies of the task and promotes the candidate only if its best scores are clearly higher (Welch t >= 2).
